name: orka
description: Search Orka context, manage project knowledge and reviews, install complete skills, and diagnose local synchronization.

interface.longDescription: Search accessible project resources, inspect revision history, save memories, update plans, and manage permissions and requests within your Orka authority. Codex and Claude Code can also install complete skills and inspect or recover synchronization through the Orka desktop app. Writes and administration require explicit OAuth consent; existing read-only connections retain their limits. ENV content is excluded.
defaultPrompt: Find the shared context and skills relevant to my project.
Save this decision to Orka and update the project plan.
Check this project’s sync health and pending requests.
